scope: Four targets: (1) under-searched proteomics repos, (2) H3 transcriptome+proteome pairs, (3) blocked vaccine transcriptomes, (4) controlled-access multimodal cohorts. Cross-checked against DATASET_MASTER_REGISTRY.md and the 20260912 prior work (W1/W2/H2/H4).

target1_under_searched_repos.access_note: All accessions listed are ProteomeXchange-federated, so each has an HTTPS-reachable PRIDE mirror even when the native repo (iProX/jPOST/MassIVE) is FTP-only or bot-blocked — pull processed peptide lists via the PRIDE FTP/HTTPS file API, preferring processed over .raw (same policy as H4).
target1_under_searched_repos.bottom_line: At least 212 NEW human-immune proteomics deposits (128 from 2024+) exist beyond the ~28 held — a ~7x expansion of the addressable immunopeptidome corpus, dominated by MassIVE+PRIDE with a directly-usable machinery/drug-perturbed cluster (ERAP PXD052175, HLA-I downregulation PXD025501, cryptic/ERV PXD059832/PXD057858, biologics-immunogenicity MAPPs PXD044851, psoriasis HLA-C PXD066040) and same-sample P+L infection sets (PXD045855). Of these, ~30 are the NON-PRIDE (MassIVE/iProX/jPOST/Panorama) deposits the program actually under-searched. Zenodo adds ~10 genuinely-new processed-peptide datasets not visible in any MS repo (incl. epiVIP paired immunopeptidome+transcriptome, Atlas9921 HLA-I motif tables). The iProX/jPOST NATIVE pool (IPX/JPST accessions that never federate to ProteomeXchange) is additional and was NOT enumerable this run (iProX 403/keyword-filter-broken/timeout) — it is the single largest untapped repo target and should be re-swept from an unblocked host with a paginated compact client.

target2_H3_transcriptome_proteome_pairs.verdict: ~2,300+ OPEN-access same-sample RNA+protein pairs are fetchable; the H3 head's '~0 same-flask held' gap is closable immediately with pre-harmonized matrices — no DAC needed.

target3_blocked_vaccine_transcriptomes.pipeline_scale: For the two big bulk-RNA-seq wins (SDY2770 260 runs + SDY1393 246 runs + SDY224 110 + SDY675): nf-core/rnaseq quant of ~600-700 FASTQ run-files (~40-64M reads each) -> gene counts -> per-subject baseline collapse -> quantile-align to the microarray matrix scale (or keep as a separate RNA-seq validation block). SDY1393 and (partly) SDY2770 have PRE-COMPUTED count objects, cutting the quant step. The 2 microarray adds (SDY400+SDY212) need only the existing gene-collapse pipeline, no SRA. DO NOT RUN — scale/route only.
target3_blocked_vaccine_transcriptomes.bottom_line: Realistic recovery raises W2 from 923 -> ~1,120-1,165 assembled (43% -> ~53-55% of the 2,125 target): SDY2770 (COVID, 80) + SDY1393 (flu, 61) are the two biggest fully-open wins, plus two trivial microarray adds (SDY400+SDY212=45) that were merely skipped. The 686-subject SDY1538 is the hard ceiling — its transcriptome is not in any public raw-read repo, so W2's 32% shortfall on that study is real and only recoverable via ImmPort-restricted access or an EPICHIPC consortium request.

target4_controlled_access_cohorts.verdict: 4 cohorts add genotype-anchored eQTL + paired scRNA/scATAC/multiome + SLE disease labels. TenK10K (best payload) and Perez SLE (lowest friction) are the priority pair; CIMA is highest-friction (China HGR regime).

cohorts.name: TenK10K (Phase 1)
cohorts.adds: Flagship multimodal slot: population-scale genotype-anchored eQTL PRIOR + paired scRNA+scATAC+multiome in the SAME donors. Fills genotype, RNA, ATAC, multiome slots at once. No protein/TCR.
cohorts.dac_route: DAC EGAC50000000931 (policy EGAP50000000872). 1) EGA account. 2) DAR via EGA portal + email DAC (joseph.powell@unsw.edu.au / Garvan). 3) Sign TenK10K Data Access Agreement (Appendix II: accessions, <=500-word abstract, personnel list). 4) Institutional Signing Official signs. 5) Garvan DAC authorizes.

cohorts.name: Perez SLE
cohorts.adds: Genotype-anchored CELL-TYPE-SPECIFIC cis-eQTLs WITH SLE disease-state labels (160 SLE + 98 control, ISG-driven states). Fills 'genotype<->expression eQTL + disease label' slot. No ATAC/protein/TCR.
cohorts.dac_route: 1) PI active eRA Commons (PI role). 2) dbGaP Authorized Access -> DAR select phs002812.v2.p1 + consent group. 3) Research Use Statement matching DUL. 4) Institutional Signing Official co-signs. 5) Data Use Certification (electronic). 6) IRB if DS- consent code. 7) NIAMS DAC review, ~2-8 wk. Verify GRU vs DS- consent code before drafting RUS.

cohorts.name: EGA SLE (Panousis/FORTH-BRFAA)
cohorts.adds: Disease-state genotype<->expression eQTL/sQTL anchor in SLE (142 SLE + 58 HC) with ready-made summary stats. Bulk blood only — value is genetics prior + SLE labels, not a multiome slot.
cohorts.dac_route: DAC EGAC00001001213 (policy EGAP00001001192, DUO managed access). 1) EGA account. 2) 'Request Access' on datasets EGAD00001005037-5042 + email gbertsias@uoc.gr. 3) Sign FORTH-BRFAA DAA (Appendix II project + personnel). 4) Institutional Signing Official. 5) Small Greek academic DAC review (PI-responsiveness-dependent).

cohorts.name: CIMA (Chinese Immune Multi-omics Atlas)
cohorts.adds: Paired scRNA+scATAC+WGS in an EAST-ASIAN/Chinese-ancestry population — the main non-European ancestry axis for the genetics prior (eQTL+caQTL). Modality-redundant with TenK10K, ancestry-complementary.
cohorts.dac_route: DAC HDAC005178 (contact liuchuanyu@genomics.cn, BGI). 1) BIG SSO account tied to real PI (+ public PI homepage URL, common rejection reason). 2) DAR: title -> research use -> HRA009968 -> sign DAA. 3) System Review -> CIMA DAC -> FTP download. NON-CHINA FRICTION (decisive): international users cannot request unless dataset is registered in the MOST Human Genetic Resource platform; typically needs a Chinese collaborating PI + advance HGRAC approval + possible cross-border security review.

target4_controlled_access_cohorts.cross_cutting_note: Only TenK10K + CIMA supply ATAC/multiome; both SLE cohorts are RNA+genotype only. NONE of the four provide protein (CyTOF/Olink) or dedicated TCR-seq — those remain gaps across all four and need a separate cohort search.
target4_controlled_access_cohorts.practical_sequencing: Start Perez SLE (fastest clean US-portal win) and TenK10K (highest payload) in parallel now; queue EGA SLE as a cheap add-on; treat CIMA as a long-lead partnership track needing a Chinese collaborator.
target4_controlled_access_cohorts.bottom_line: These 4 cohorts are the multimodal/genotype-prior fill: ~2,600 donors of genotype+scRNA (+scATAC/multiome in ~2,350) and SLE disease labels. Value-per-effort order: TenK10K > Perez SLE > EGA SLE > CIMA. All require DAC turnaround (weeks to months); none are quick pulls, so start the two priority DARs immediately.

overall_bottom_line.how_much_more_usable_data: Substantial across ALL objectives, not just H4:
ranked_by_value_per_effort: 1. H3 pairs via `cptac` pip package (~1,000+ same-tumor RNA+protein, pre-aligned, OPEN, one pip install) + ProCan/Gygi (~1,200 cell-line pairs) => ~2,300+ OPEN same-sample transcriptome+proteome pairs, closing the H3 '~0 held' gap OUTRIGHT with zero DAC. THE single biggest quick win.

2. Target-1 immunopeptidome: >=212 NEW human-immune proteomics deposits (128 from 2024+) beyond the ~28 held (~7x the addressable corpus), all ProteomeXchange-federated => HTTPS-pullable; ~30 are the non-PRIDE (MassIVE/iProX/jPOST/Panorama) ones actually under-searched. Directly-usable perturbation cluster: ERAP (PXD052175), HLA-I downregulation (PXD025501), cryptic/ERV (PXD059832/PXD057858), MAPPs biologics-immunogenicity (PXD044851), same-sample P+L COVID (PXD045855). Plus ~10 new Zenodo processed-peptide datasets (epiVIP paired immunopeptidome+transcriptome, Atlas9921). The iProX/jPOST NATIVE pool (IPX/JPST accessions, 403/timeout-blocked this run) is the largest untapped repo target.

3. Vaccine (T3) recovery: ~201 subjects cleanly recoverable (SDY2770 COVID + SDY1393 flu the big wins; 2 trivial microarray adds) + 44 via ArrayExpress => W2 923->~1,120-1,165 (43%->~54%). Bounded by the genuinely-blocked SDY1538 (686, not public).
4. Controlled-access cohorts (T4): ~2,600 donors of genotype+scRNA(+ATAC/multiome) + SLE labels; start TenK10K + Perez SLE DARs now (weeks-months turnaround).
overall_bottom_line.single_fastest_win: The `cptac` Python package for H3 — one pip install yields ~1,000+ pre-aligned same-sample RNA+protein pairs across 10 cancer cohorts, fully OPEN, closing the H3 modality gap the program currently scores at ~0 held.
overall_bottom_line.blocked_data_confirmed_unrecoverable_pub: SDY1538/SDY2584 vaccine RNA-seq (776 subj, EPICHIPC — ImmPort-restricted/consortium only) and MSV000091285 (H4 immunoproteasome ONX-0914 — MassIVE FTP-only, needs FTP-capable host, same transport blocker as many MassIVE files here).
